author: official
summary: Counts down to a deadline in the visitor’s browser, as plain digits or split-flap cards, and hides or swaps itself at the deadline.

attributes.name: data-deadline
attributes.description: ISO date-time WITH an explicit offset (Z or ±hh:mm) naming a real date; otherwise the root is left as authored.

attributes.name: data-expired
attributes.description: What the root does at the deadline: hide it, or replace its content with data-expired-text (text without a data-expired-text hides).

attributes.name: data-expired-text
attributes.description: Text shown in place of the countdown when data-expired is text.

attributes.name: data-part
attributes.description: On a child element: which unit it shows, two digits minimum and as many as needed (no upper bound). The largest unit present also carries every unit above it (hours alone show 53 for 2 d 5 h).

attributes.name: data-flip
attributes.description: On a data-part element: show one split-flap card per digit instead of plain text. data-flip="false" keeps plain text.

attributes.name: data-flip-faces
attributes.description: On a data-flip element: comma-separated faces its cards can show. Every card is locked to the widest of them; the same ordered list is the drum order a future drum mode would step through.
